summary: Implements the harness's P8 EvalCard analog: score.py assembles a non-gating `validity:` block into summary.yaml (per-judge P8 triple read defensively from WS2's stability.irr_* keys; three layer stanzas with unmeasured layers NAMED; V_total as conceptual frame only — no product ever computed; same-provider-family caveat computed conservatively, silent on gateway aliases). report.py renders it as _render_validity between Scoring Summary and Regressions, plus a displayed-precision caveat treatment on Scoring Summary means (gap 8: annotate n + footnote, never truncate). log_results.py routes the block to MLflow (gap 6) as metrics ({judge}/irr_value — plottable cross-run), tags (validity/v1..v3 statuses, validity/same_family, validity/{judge}/irr_metric — searchable), full fidelity via the already-logged summary.yaml artifact; params rejected (they are immutable inputs, validity is an outcome). eval-anova gains agent_eval/anova/stats/reliability.py (pingouin.intraclass_corr behind ANOVA_AVAILABLE) computing per-condition ICC(2,1)/ICC(2,k) with CI95 over the pre-collapse (case, replication) frame — per-judge via new judge:: columns in load_conditions_from_runs — written as a 'reliability' key in anova.json, captioned 'pipeline test-retest (agent+judge variance confounded)', rendered read-only by compare.py. Gap 4: one low-alpha→construct-development paragraph in eval-optimize SKILL.md. V3-3 has no verdict; analogous corrections from the V3-1/V3-2 verdicts are incorporated: tier defaults resolved at assembly time (never mutating config.thresholds, which harbor/run.py:329 reads as a required-judges set); the coefficient labeled 'single-judge self-consistency alpha (upper bound on inter-rater reliability)'; Sec 5.3 not 6.4 in any authored citation; validity is explicitly non-gating so the top-level-block-invisible-to-cmd_regression trap (V3-2 #1) cannot fire; human_agreement passthrough labeled 'agreement with a single human reviewer (n=X)'; Harbor-produced summaries render the section honestly as not-computed; no Landis-Koch labels anywhere.
depends_on: WS2 (V3-1) — SOFT dependency: WS7 reads the per-judge IRR triple from summary['judges'][name]['stability'] keys {irr_metric, irr_value, n_units, rationale|irr_rationale, fleiss_kappa}, plus JudgeConfig.consequence and thresholds.min_alpha. Without WS2 every surface degrades gracefully: judge rows render '—' with the 'run with samples >= 3' hint, threshold column shows '—', and no MLflow irr metrics are emitted. NEW module behind the anova extra (module-level `import pandas as pd` / `import pingouin as pg`, mirroring anova.py:22-23 — NEVER imported from the eval-run scoring path, which cannot have scipy/pingouin). Module docstring states the confound up front. Constants: RELIABILITY_CAPTION = 'pipeline test-retest (agent+judge variance confounded)'. One function: `cross_replication_icc(df, *, targets='case_id', raters='replication', ratings='composite') -> dict` returning {'icc2': float|None, 'icc2_ci95': [float, float]|None, 'icc2k': float|None, 'icc2k_ci95': [...]|None, 'n_targets': int, 'n_raters': int, 'note': str|None}. Behavior: drop rows where ratings is null, recount targets/raters; guards returning None-values + note (never a fabricated coefficient, mirroring anova.py:44-54's degenerate handling): n_raters < 2 → 'single replication — ICC undefined; run with replications >= 2'; n_targets < 2 → 'fewer than 2 cases'; zero variance in ratings → 'no variance in ratings — ICC undefined (all scores identical)'; call pg.intraclass_corr(data=..., targets=..., raters=..., ratings=..., nan_policy='omit') in try/except (any exception → note with str(exc)); extract rows Type=='ICC2' (McGraw-Wong two-way random, single measure, absolute agreement — the ICC(A,1) analog) and Type=='ICC2k'; cast numpy scalars to plain float and CI95% arrays to [float, float]; NaN coefficient → None + note; negative ICC is passed through un-clamped (consistent with the harness's never-clamp stance). Docstring notes: raters are whole-run replications assigned by discovery order (analyze.py rep_counter), so rater identity = run identity within a condition; listwise omission of incomplete cases via nan_policy='omit'; this is pipeline test-retest, NOT judge IRR.
